name: Scale Field Computation
definition: A 3D scalar field S mapping a point x to a local scale t, encoding size information for volume exploration. It is defined as the fitting of a continuous function S to a set of salient points {xi; ti} from scale-space, ensuring continuity.
summary: Scale Field Computation estimates local feature size via iterative non-linear diffusion, enabling sub-voxel scale detection without the granularity limitations of pyramid-based approaches.
